ImageDescription.value: The Chicago Stock Yard Kilty Band marching past the historic entrance gate of the Union Stock Yards in Chicago, 1965. The gateway signage marks the centennial of the Union Stock Yards (1865–1965). Founded in 1921 and affiliated with American Legion Post 333, the band maintained close ties to the Stock Yards and its surrounding community, regularly performing in parades and civic events. The photograph bears a “Knowles” mark in the lkower right corner, though no formal copyright notice is present and no further information about the photographer or studio has been identified.

Credit.value: Chicago Stock Yard Kilty Band archives (private collection)

The ballroom featured walls lined with portraits of prominent figures in the livestock industry. The Inn and club were central to the social and professional life of the Union Stock Yards. Founded in 1921 and affiliated with American Legion Post 333, the band frequently performed at social functions, dances, and civic events connected to the Stock Yards community.

ImageDescription.value:
GoPro is a perfect example of a 4SDX springboard effect.
That happens at deep dips within larger Uptrends.  The Signal Line of Level Four swoops down to the zero line as the price goes to the 55-day moving average.  Next, the MACD Line crosses above both the Signal Line and zero, 4SMUX.  That usually give the price a push higher.
